title: Orchestrated log sampler and conditional trace collector
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds an orchestrated, policy-driven log sampler and conditional trace collector to reduce noise and collect targeted diagnostic bundles during incidents. Includes responder CLI, privacy redaction hooks, and opt-in ephemeral debug jobs. Backwards-compatible; feature gated and off by default.
description:
Motivation: During high-volume incidents we either collect too much telemetry (cost, noise) or miss the narrow correlated traces that reveal causal chains. This PR introduces an orchestrated log sampler and a conditional trace collector that lets responders capture small, high-fidelity diagnostic bundles without blasting the system with full sampling.

What this PR does: implements a policy engine that drives adaptive sampling decisions, correlation-aware trace lookups, and a safe, pre-authorized ephemeral debug job runner. Key capabilities: adaptive prefix-and-field sampling, correlation-context propagation (trace/log span keys), conditional trace fetching (only collect spans when correlation score exceeds threshold), responder-initiated snapshot CLI (with RBAC checks), automatic PII redaction hooks configurable per-team, retention and upload policy controls, and a canary rollout for customer tenants.

Checklist: [x] policy engine implementation (pkg/sampler), [x] trace collector (pkg/tracer), [x] responder CLI + auth checks (cmd/oncall-sampler), [x] unit + integration tests (test/unit/*, test/integration/*), [x] docs and runbook update (docs/runbooks/orchestrated-sampling.md), [x] privacy redactors plumbed and tested.

Usage notes: Feature is behind the feature-flag "orchestrated_sample_v1" and off in default config. Operators can enable sampling policies via the console or Helm values (deploy/helm/values.yaml). Responders can call: redwood-incident-sampler collect --incident-id INC12345 --policy fast-path --dry-run to preview.

Security & privacy: Collection requires an on-call role scope; the CLI checks the session token against the RBAC service. PII redactors are applied by default with a team-configurable allowlist; we run an additional scrub pass before any upload/export. Audit events are emitted for every collection.

Rollout plan: Canary on internal SRE org (2 weeks), + gradual tenant ramp. Rollback is a flip of the feature flag and Helm value.

Related: linear/ENG-1284 implements the policy DSL; ENG-1299 is the follow-up for sampling telemetry dashboards. SUP-4321 is the support ticket that motivated the responder CLI.

Notes: This description is intentionally a single continuous string to match PR storage format.
